name: ArcasyaAI
title: ArcasyaAI MCP
description: Grok-powered ArcasyaAI MCP — hosted agents, long-term memory, and social toolkit. Documentation snapshot only; the live server card / well-known metadata is published on secure.arcasya.ai.

bearer.note: Advanced, for clients that cannot complete OAuth. Grok Bot and the Cursor marketplace listing are OAuth only. This is not a Cursor plugin setting. See docs/mcp.api-key.example.json.

internalOnlyScopes.note: Internal only. Not granted to public clients. The hosted server hides the tools behind these scopes from public users.

publicTools: matrix (overview, search, node, traverse, table, write, update, link)

mcpApps.note: Optional cards. Tools still return text and structured content when the host does not render ui://.

note: Documentation snapshot for marketplace reviewers. Public matrix tools land with arcasyaai-v3 matrix V1. The live authorization server still advertises the full scopes_supported list. A new public client that omits scope receives publicDefaultScopes only. If the live metadata and this snapshot disagree, the hosted files win.
